articles.summary: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESQ) (the "Company"), the financial holding company for Esquire Bank, National Association ("Esquire Bank" or the "Bank"), (collectively "Esquire") today announced that the Company will release earnings for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. (ET). The Company will conduct a conference call on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (ET), during which Andrew C. Sagliocca, Vice Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President, and Michael Lacapria, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will discuss Esquire's third quarter financial performance, followed by a question-and-answer period. The live audio webcast can be accessed via the following link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/886920992 Corresponding presentation slides and a replay of the conference call will be available on Esquire's Investor Relations web page at investorrelations.esquirebank.com . articles.title: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call on October 27, 2026
